name: E2E core 1125: where scenario results live
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'where do I see my scenario test results?'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy tells the user where scenario results live in the product (naming the Simulations/Scenarios section).
The reply contains no worker-side address: no localhost, no 127.0.0.1, no container port, no raw environment-variable placeholder standing in for a host.
